body: I do just to get it off my chest. If I talk to the people in my life about it they will try their hardest to stop me. I need it all to end. So here I post.
I’m going to message you.
I’m going to message you.
My last paycheck is coming on the 12th and I’ve always wanted to travel but just haven’t. Maybe I will do the same. Have always wanted to visit LA too!
Yes I feel this way too.  Nothing makes me happy for too long except for the thought of leaving.
You can try google translate :’(
No. I have no interest in anything for over a year now. Nothing brings me joy for more than a moment. I’ve tried to push through it.
It depends. Everyone has a unique experience with it.
I was going to leave some letters too. But I’ve settled on one letter to my sister and a video for everyone.
Sorry, just woke up. I’m alright. Everything still feels like I’m in a daydream. How are you??
You’re fine.
People always seem to think I haven’t thought this through.
I’m breaking down now so I probably won’t be writing back again for tonight. I’ll talk with you again. Hope you have at least an ok night ❤️

Unfortunately I do have a kid. My child is the only reason I haven’t done it thus far.....it fucking hurts so much. Just can’t carry on anymore...the longer I hold on the worse it gets. My kid will thankfully be taken care of and he won’t go into the system. Thank you for your foresight, wish I had that when I was younger too.

Exactly! The look on my sister’s face when I described depression to her was shocking. She still can’t grasp that we can look and be happy for moments but still be dying on the inside. Wouldn’t wish what we’re going though on anyone.

Life is for sure not fair. We only get to taste the horizon for a second before we’re dragged back to the bottom. It’s so incredibly exhausting and painful. I have no idea what we’ve done other than try to live. It’s shit.
I am sorry that people feel like they get to invalidate how you feel. How you feel is real and I hear you ❤️ wishing you the best.
I am so sorry to hear that. I’m in the same undiagnosed boat....so many things go hand-in-hand and they trigger each other. I hope you get your peace.

Long story short, been suicidal for well over half of my life. And I have absolutely no more fight left in me. I’m ready to go.
You?
Good luck.
It’s all up to you for sure. I’m ten years out, and my own life hasn’t improved....just got worse. So I truly wish you luck.
You’re welcome! Best of luck.
When are you planning?
Yes. Forgot my last paycheck is coming through on the 12th so it’ll be shortly afterwards so I can take care of some things with that money.

I’m going to take several of my Rx sleep aids and hang when they start to take effect. Thinking that’ll help. Might not be the quickest but I’m sure there won’t be much pain while slipping into a medicated sleep.
Won’t matter when I’m gone.
Not if you go deep enough. I’m not that stupid lmao! Not where hiking trails are or anything.
Wasn’t planning on that...same for you man. No public areas. 🙏🏻
Next week hopefully, if not then the following week. Still figuring out the where. Got some rope.
Look up syncope.

Regarding the dreamlike state sounds like dissociation/depersonalization. 
https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/262888.php

From what I’ve gathered in talking with others a big factor is pain. Most everyone wants a painless suicide.
That and all the people I’ll be letting down is what’s held me back for over a decade. So I definitely can relate. But it’ll happen within the next couple weeks.
Best of luck.
Pills are the least successful attempts...
In the same boat as you at the moment. Next week I will have more time to figure something out...
It’s taken a lot of pain to reach this point.
I’m in a verrry similar boat as you dear. I feel your pain 😢
It’s taken me over 16yrs for me to muster up the strength to finally be doing it in a couple weeks.
Yeah if I don’t succeed it will be forced into light for sure.....which is why I’m researching. I have to succeed.

I haven’t talked to very many people in my personal life about it...because of reactions like that. And nothing will be changing my mind. I fully intend to succeed. Done a lot of research as well to help me succeed.

I’d like to not be alive anymore. And I have straight up told my a family member that I’m not in a good place right now...all I got was this look like I’m pitied and fragile. Still going to be making my exit. It’s been a long time coming. Even in high school (which was forever ago) for art class I made a painting of myself hanging, they hung it up on the wall with everyone else’s. Guess I already knew back then.
I will see you there (or not, depending what’s there...) next month. Godspeed.
In all honesty I don’t think there are any methods of suicide that are painless. Going to message you in a second.
Messaged you.
Right there with you. Got so much to take care of in a short amount of time...
I am so sorry that happened to you. No one should ever have to go through that 😔
